text: DSH Subagent Model Picker 是一款面向 DSH Web 的子代理模型选择插件，在对话输入栏旁加入独立的 Sub 模型选择器，并通过服务接口读取模型目录、保存每个主会话的选择。用户可以为后续新建的子代理选择提供方、模型和支持的推理强度，也可以使用继承模式；已创建子代理保留固定绑定，子会话中的选择器为只读。适合需要让子代理使用不同模型、同时保留主对话模型设置的 DSH Web 用户。安装需兼容版本的 DSH Web 与 Node.js；代码未声明额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Subagent Model Picker adds a selector beside the DSH Web conversation input. Choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for new subagents, or inherit the main session's selection. Existing children keep their binding. Requires compatible DSH Web and Node.js; no API key is declared.
我想给新建的子代理单独选一个模型，不影响主对话。
能不能按会话设置子代理使用的模型和推理强度？
Let me choose a provider and model for future subagents while keeping the parent conversation's model unchanged.
DSH Subagent Model Picker 的功能「子代理模型策略」：在主会话输入栏选择提供方、模型和推理强度或使用继承设置，保存后用于新建子代理；子代理启动时捕获绑定，后续请求按该绑定路由。

dsh-subagent-model-policy README · DSH Subagent Model Picker：Choose a different model and reasoning effort for new subagents without changing the main conversation's model.

- **Separate Sub: picker** beside the normal model picker.
- **Per-conversation settings**, with Inherited as the default.
- **Existing subagents keep their model**, including after continuation or restart.
- **Immediate saves** and a read-only picker on child conversations.

**Version:** 0.1.0 · **License:** MIT

dsh-subagent-model-policy README · Quick start：Requires DSH Web **0.1.2-rc.1**, Node **22.19+ in the 22.x line or 24+**, and npm/pnpm on PATH. The clone option also requires Git. Run this on the machine where DSH runs, using its usual account and environment.

1. From a directory where you want to keep the plugin, run in a Linux/macOS shell:

```sh
git clone --branch v0.1.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/chr003/dsh-subagent-model-picker.git &&
cd dsh-subagent-model-picker &&
npm run setup &&
npm run check &&

dsh-subagent-model-policy README · Quick start：2. Once active work finishes, restart your existing DSH instance and refresh its Web page. Look for **Sub:** beside the main model picker.

This installs the tested **v0.1.0 release**. Keep the plugin directory in place because DSH links to it. If your Web profile isn't named `web`, substitute its name in the command.

dsh-subagent-model-policy README · Quick start：**Without Git:** Download the [v0.1.0 source ZIP](https://github.com/chr003/dsh-subagent-model-picker/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.zip), extract it into a permanent directory, and open a terminal there. Run the commands above starting at npm run setup, then restart as described.

**Need PowerShell, a custom runtime path, or help?** See the [installation guide](docs/INSTALLATION.md).

dsh-subagent-model-policy README · Usage：Open **Sub:** and choose a provider, model and supported reasoning effort. Changes save immediately and affect **new subagents only**. **Inherited** keeps DSH's normal selection—usually the parent model, but explicit model/provider options from a spawning tool still apply. An explicit Sub: selection overrides those options.

dsh-subagent-model-policy README · Usage：Children with successfully saved bindings keep their captured model and effort across continuation and restart. Newly created descendants use the owning root conversation's latest explicit policy, or DSH's normal selection when it is Inherited. Children created before installation remain unmanaged.

Ordinary conversation forks have independent settings. Child conversation views are read-only. Save and validation failures are shown rather than silently switching managed children to another model.

dsh-subagent-model-policy README · Usage：**Known limitation:** If a new child's initial binding save fails, restarting DSH can leave that child unmanaged and using DSH's normal model choice instead. Fix storage and create a new child; see [recovery guidance](docs/INSTALLATION.md#initial-binding-save-failure).

dsh-subagent-model-policy README · Compatibility：Tested on **Linux with Node 22.22.3 / 24.19.0 and DSH 0.1.2-rc.1**. All 61 automated tests pass, including a real archive roundtrip. Setup checks the qualified native libraries rather than installing another DSH/Cordis copy. macOS and Windows are not yet independently qualified.

This plugin controls standard in-process DSH subagents, not separate Codex or Claude CLI products. Cross-model vision support needs separate qualification. See [architecture and limitations](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
